pcs.pc_description: abide with the supervisor's time limitations
check for cracks and wear in the turret and undercarriage
make sure that there is no abnormal wear or cracked teeth in the tracks & sprockets
check for dents and cracks on the welded areas of the boom and the stick
ensure that the oil levels in the engine, radiator coolant, final drive and hydraulic oil and top up, if necessary as per manufacturer's recommendations
check the fan belt tension
set the rear and side mirrors for correct viewing position
check for leaks in the hydraulic hoses and cylinders
carry out inspections to verify that the horn and work lights are in proper working order
check battery electrolyte level and terminal tightness
inspect the different controls, gauges, warning lights, and confirm that all safety and maintenance stickers are present
check and adjust the operator seat, seat belts and set them as per comfort level
check the circle turn gear and clean if required
ensure that the air filter dust bowls are clean, and that the gasket and inner filter are in good condition
check and ensure that all cabin controls including electronic display are functioning properly
drain the water and debris from the fuel tank
make sure that all the pins, bushings and pivot points are properly greased
maintain clean footplates and steps free of mud, dirt and oil
before operation, ensure that no one is beneath or on the machine
maintain a Inspection/maintenance logbook to record all activities performed before starting the excavator
report defects precisely to the supervisor if beyond scope of his role

pcs.pc_description: plan and arrange the work in accordance with the instructions
examine the jobsite for loose soil, concealed deep ditches, or marshy spots where the excavator might become trapped
using the ignition switch, start the engine
in cold season, use the priming pump and pre-heater to start the engine
identify and choose the proper attachment to be required for the task at hand on the job site
use the emergency stop button to disable all power to the excavator in case of a crisis, as per operator manual
report any issues/problems encountered while operating the excavator to the supervisor
assure that the excavator load and operating speed are within the manufacturer's specifications
keep a close eye out for workers and dangers such as trenches, potholes, and wires
make visual inspections on essential temperature and pressure gauges while they are in operation
abide with the supervisor's time limitations
make sure that no other operators travel on or near the excavator
ensure that walkway rules e.g. operating the excavator within the permissible/ allocated areas are followed
use the excavator's signaling equipment wisely, such as the turn signal, parking indication and air horn
before tipping over an edge, stay a safe distance from it and utilize an authorized stop block
maintain a safe distance from other plants and vehicles
judge the grade of the excavator travel limitation and operate accordingly
ensure that excavator is always parked on firm, level ground; with handbrake applied and drive and controls disengaged
operate the body hoist control handle to maneuver the hydraulic ram that tips the dump
release the load securely in the place and manner specified by the supervisor

pcs.pc_description: monitoring machine working hours allows you to determine the best service plan
at regular intervals, clean the dust bowls of air filter
at regular intervals, clean the footplates, pedals, and stairs of mud, grime, ice, and snow
everyday drain the water and debris from the fuel tank
check and top up coolants, lubricants and all fluids everyday
grease all pins and bushings of pivot points everyday
check battery acid levels and terminal condition, and do minor adjustments as needed
if a fault is found that is outside the scope of his duty, notify the supervisor immediately
before performing any repair, be certain that the machine is on firm and level ground
timely completion of daily / weekly maintenance sheets as provided by the company
while doing maintenance, be sure that appropriate props/support devices are utilized and that the bucket is not lifted
make sure that no engine repair is conducted while the engine is running or remains hot
troubleshoot and analyze the problem
handle and dispose waste based on environmental guidelines at the work place
adhere to the reporting procedures established by the employer
complete all documents in accordance with the required standards in a timely way
report and escalate problems/ incidents as required in a timely manner

pcs.pc_description: Comply with safety, health, security and environment related regulations/guidelines at the work site
use personal protective equipment (ppe) and other safety gear as applicable to the equipment and the worksite
Follow safety measures during operations to ensure that the health and safety of self or others (including members of the public) is not at risk
Carry out operations as per the manufacturer's and worksite related health and safety guidelines
Handle the transport, storage and disposal of hazardous materials and waste in compliance with worksite health, safety and environmental guidelines
operate various grades of fire extinguishers, as applicable
support in administering basic first aid and report to concerned team members, as required, in case of an accident
respond promptly and appropriately to an accident/ incident or emergency, within limits of your role and responsibility
record and report details related to operations, incidents or accidents, as applicable
